children: Muscat: The official price of Oman oil, for delivery in next November, settled today at 101.84 US dollars.
Oman oil price today recorded an increase of 0.28 US dollars compared to the price of yesterday Wednesday which stood at 101.56 US Dollars.

It is worth noting that the monthly average price of Oman crude oil for delivery in September 2026 amounted to 76.36 US dollars, marking a decline of 2.73 US dollars compared to the delivery price for August.
